title: Ibiden
summary: Japanese substrate maker and long-standing lead supplier of FC-BGA substrates for high-end processors.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Ibiden is one of the largest suppliers of flip-chip ball-grid-array substrates and has been a lead partner for Intel and other processor vendors for years. It is investing in larger, higher-layer substrates for AI accelerators, where package size and power delivery push organic substrate technology to its limits. Substrate capacity, not demand, has been the binding constraint in recent cycles.

Technology Exposure

  • FC-BGA substrates for CPUs, GPUs and accelerators
  • Ceramic and other electronic components
  • Substrate capacity in Japan and overseas

What To Watch

  • AI substrate capacity additions
  • Customer concentration and programme ramps
  • Capital intensity and depreciation

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.

businessMeaning: The largest packages in the industry are qualified on a handful of substrate lines; Ibiden's capacity is a strategic asset.
investmentLens: A high-quality franchise with cyclical orders and heavy capex; the AI substrate ramp is the key variable.
